terminal_piece_desc: A computer that plays Valheim. Sit down and steer the Proxy, a second character out in the world, while the screen shows what it sees for everyone nearby.
terminal_server_missing: Quad's Terminal isn't installed on this server, so terminals can't be built here
terminal_proxy_far: The Proxy was too far from the terminal and has been brought back
terminal_desktop_hint: Double-click an icon to start it. Escape goes back to this desktop.
terminal_crash_text: The program closed unexpectedly. You can start it again.
terminal_browser_address: Web address, or words to search for
terminal_browser_home_hint: Click the address bar at the top and type a web address or some words to search for. Click a link to follow it. The mouse wheel turns the pages.
terminal_browser_limits: This is a simple browser: it shows the text of a page and its links. There are no pictures, scripts or logins.
terminal_browser_off: The browser is switched off on this server.
terminal_browser_notloaded: This page is on {0}, which your game doesn't load for other players' browsing.
terminal_browser_https: Only secure (https) addresses can be opened.
terminal_browser_port: Only the normal secure port can be used.
terminal_browser_private: Addresses on a home or private network can't be opened.
terminal_browser_toobig: That page is too big to load.
terminal_browser_failed: The site answered with an error ({0}).
terminal_browser_type: This kind of file can't be shown ({0}).
terminal_browser_redirects: The site sent the browser round in circles.
terminal_browser_broken: The browser could not show this page.
terminal_scripts_missing: The Scripts mod is not installed on this game, so this program has nothing to run.
terminal_scripts_readonly: You can read scripts here but only the server's owner can run or change them.
terminal_scripts_clipboard_empty: The clipboard is empty: copy a script first.
terminal_scripts_cant: A script could not be made.
terminal_scripts_delete_again: Click Delete again to delete this script.
terminal_scripts_name: A name for the new script
terminal_scripts_power_items: give you small amounts of items
terminal_scripts_power_weather: change the weather and the time
terminal_scripts_power_net: send messages to a web address (careful)
